data.question: Tingkat kemiskinan Papua Pegunungan tahun 2025 berapa persen?

value.raw_question: Tingkat kemiskinan Papua Pegunungan tahun 2025 berapa persen?

value.sql:
SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T1.periode, SUM(T2.nilai) * 100 / COUNT(T2.nilai) AS persen
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T2.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T1.periode
ORDER BY T2.nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS total_nilai
FROM 
    provinsi
JOIN 
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY 
    total_nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,

WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, T2.nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY T2.nilai DESC; -- assuming you want to rank by descending order

SELECT
  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  periode,
  SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM
  nilai_indikator
  INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
  provinsi.nama,
  periode
ORDER BY
  nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS total_nilai
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY
    total_nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama
ORDER BY nilai DESC;
